name: Cable Seated Shoulder Internal Rotation
steps: Sit sideways on a bench with the working shoulder nearest an elbow-height cable and grasp its handle with your elbow bent against your side.
Rotate your forearm inward to draw your hand across your abdomen.
Guide your hand outward toward the pulley.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your working elbow tucked so the movement comes from the shoulder.
Keep your torso upright and avoid twisting your chest toward the hand.
